test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The pie-chart given below shows the monthly expenditure incurred by a family on various heads as a percentage of the total monthly income of the family. </f
solution:
given:

Expenses on house rent = 14%

Total monthly income of the family = Rs.70,000

Concept used:

Percentage share = Percentage × Total amount

Calculation:

Amount spent by the family on house rent = 14% × 70000

Amount spent by the family on house rent = (14)/(100)×70000

Amount spent by the family on house rent = 700 × 14 = Rs 9,800

The monthly expenditure incurred by the family on the rent of the house is Rs 9,800
